full.en: NOOTROPIC TEA, 120 g - Instant tea blend, ginkgo biloba extract support blood circulation in brain and enhancement of cognitive performance. Ingredients: instant tea blend (maltodextrin, white tea extract (5%), vitamin C (ascorbic acid)), pineapple flavor, ginkgo biloba (ginkgo biloba) extract. Using advice: recommended daily amount is 5 g (1 teaspoon). Mix in a glass (150 mL) of warm water and drink. Storage: store in a cool and dry place.

Uporabe: vmešajte 5 g (1 čajno žličko) v kozarec tople vode (150 mL) in popijte. Shranjevanje: hranite v suhem in hladnem prostoru.
